text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One day, while walking around campus, I hear a familiar voice… but saying some very unfamiliar words.

text_block_list.name: Cat-Lover Umamusume?
text_block_list.text: Meeeowww… What a cute widdle kittyyy! So cuuute, yes you are!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Sigh… Cats really take away all the exhausti—

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: …Can you take away Trainer's memory too, Mr. Cat?! Please?!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Yeah, I figured as much. You're just a little kitty!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Ughhhh… I can't… I'm even more tired now…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She appears exhausted and low on energy. I wonder if I should reconsider her race schedule for the sake of her future success.
